title: The legend of Vishvamitra, continued
introduction: On Vishvamitra's performing severe ascesis Brahma accords the sageship of 'Great-sage' to him, whereas Vishvamitra's ambition is to acquire the sageship of a 'Brahma-sage' Absolute-sageship. In the meanwhile, the celestial wench Menaka arrives at that place and Vishvamitra is enticed by her beauty and spends some years with her. Later, on realising the he should have won over lust, he further undertakes severe ascesis, by which gods are perturbed.
closing: The word vi in the name of Vishvamitra is taken as the third syllable in Gayatri Hymn.
इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 63rd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु व्रतस्नातं महामुनिम् |
अभ्यागच्छन् सुराः सर्वे तपःफलचिकीर्षवः
verses.iast:
pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu vrata snātam mahāmunim |
abhyāgaccan surāḥ sarve tapaḥ phala cikīrṣavaḥ
verses.translation: "When thousand years are completed in ascesis and when that great saint Vishvamitra took a bath of solemnity, all the gods have come forward wishing to accord the fruit of that ascesis to Vishvamitra." Thus Sage Shataananda continued the legend of Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: ascesis, fruit, wishing [to accord to Vishvamitra]

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीत् सुमहातेजा ब्रह्मा सुरुचिरं वचः |
ऋषिस्त्वमसि भद्रं ते स्वार्जितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः
verses.iast:
abravīt su mahātejā brahmā su ruciram vacaḥ |
ṛṣiḥ tvam asi bhadram te sva arjitaiḥ kar.hmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: "The very highly resplendent Brahma spoke to him with highly palatable words, 'you have now become a kingly sage by virtue of auspicious deeds you have personally undertaken, let safeness betide you.'
notes: Vividly: 'so far, you are a king and by your auspicious deeds now you have become a 'kingly sage' rājaṣi and to attain a still higher brahmarṣi 'Absolute sageship' you are not yet merited... as the Absolute sageship will be endowed to those who are above the negative traits of humans, like greed, anger, lust, jealousy etc.'

glosses.meaning: sage, you are - you have become
to you, let there be safety.

verses.devanagari:
तमेवमुक्त्वा देवेशस्त्रिदिवं पुनरभ्यगात् |
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा भूयस्तेपे महत्तपः
verses.iast:
tam evam uktvā deveśaḥ tridivam punaḥ abhyagāt |
viśvāmitro mahātejā bhūyaḥ tepe mahat tapaḥ
verses.translation: "On speaking to Vishvamitra in that way Brahma returned to heaven, and that highly vigorous Vishvamitra again performed a great ascesis.

glosses.meaning: to him, in that way, on speaking
again, towards, to heaven came [came back]

verses.devanagari:
ततः कालेन महता मेनका परमाप्सराः |
पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ स्नातुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā menakā parama apsarāḥ |
puṣkareṣu nara śreṣṭha snātum samupacakrame
verses.translation: Then at a long lost time Menaka, the prominent apsara, celestial wench, has arrived and started to swim for sport in that holy lake.

glosses.meaning: a great, after time - at a long lost time
in holy lake, to take bath, started to - started a swimming for sport.

verses.devanagari:
तां ददर्श महातेजा मेनकां कुशिकात्मजः |
रूपेणाप्रतिमां तत्र विद्युतं जलदे यथा
verses.iast:
tām dadarśa mahātejā menakām kuśika ātmajaḥ |
rūpeṇa apratimām tatra vidyutam jalade yathā
verses.translation: "That great resplendent sage Vishvamitra has seen Menaka who is incomparable in her mien and comparable to an electric-flash in a black-cloud, while she is swimming in the holy lake.

glosses.meaning: by mien, not, matchabe - an incomparable one
at her, Menaka, he has seen.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा कन्दर्पवशगो मुनिस्तामिदमब्रवीत् |
अप्सरः स्वागतं तेऽस्तु वस चेह ममाश्रमे
अनुगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते मदनेन सुमोहितम् |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā kandarpa vaśago muniḥ tām idam abravīt |
apsaraḥ svāgatam te astu vasa ca iha mama āśrame
anugṛhṇīṣva bhadram te madanena su mohitam |
verses.translation: "On seeing her the sage having gone under the sway o Love-god said this to her, 'oh, apsara, you are welcome, I invite you to bide in my hermitage. Oblige me who am bewitched by Love-god for you. You be safe.

glosses.meaning: oh, apsara, to you, welcome, is there
mine, here, in hermitage, you stay, also

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्ता सा वरारोहा तत्र वासमथाकरोत्
तपसो हि महाविघ्नो विश्वामित्रमुपागतम् |
तस्यां वसन्त्यां वर्षाणि पंच पंच च राघव
विश्वामित्राश्रमे सौम्य सुखेन व्यतिचक्रमुः |
verses.iast:
iti uktā sā varārohā tatra vāsam atha akarot
tapaso hi mahāvighno viśvāmitram upāgatam |
tasyām vasantyām var.hṣāṇi pañca pañca ca rāghava
viśvāmitra āśrame sauṃya sukhena vyaticakramuḥ |
verses.translation: "When he said thus to her, oh, Raghava, then she made a stopover there and ten years rolled by comfortably, and oh, gentle Rama, because of her staying Vishvamitra is indeed faced with a great hindrance in his ascesis.

glosses.meaning: she, that beautiful nymph, thus, she who is spoken to
by her, in Vishvamitra's, hermitage, while staying

verses.devanagari:
अथ काले गते तस्मिन् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
सव्रीड इव संवृत्तश्चिन्ताशोकपरायणः |
बुद्धिर्मुनेः समुत्पन्ना सामर्षा रघुनंदन
verses.iast:
atha kāle gate tasmin viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
sa vrīḍa iva saṃvṛttaḥ cintā śoka parāyaṇaḥ |
buddhir muneḥ samutpannā sa amarṣā raghunandana
verses.translation: "Then after the lapse of that ten year period Vishvamitra became doleful with distress and he is enwrapped in humiliation, as it were, and, oh, Rama, Raghu's legatee, then a resentful thought occurred to him.

glosses.meaning: then, that [ten years,] time, having elapsed
great-saint, Vishvamitra, with distress, doleful, he became

verses.devanagari:
सर्वं सुराणां कर्मैतत्तपोऽपहरणं महत् |
अहो रात्रापदेशेन गताः संवत्सरा दश
काममोहाभिभूतस्य विघ्नोऽयं प्रत्युपस्थितः |
verses.iast:
sarvam surāṇām karma etat tapo apaharaṇam mahat |
aho rātrā apadeśena gatāḥ saṃvatsarā daśa
kāma moha abhibhūtasya vighno ayam pratyupasthitaḥ |
verses.translation: " 'All this is the mischief of gods to defraud me of the great merit of my ascesis. Ten years have rolled by as if they are just a day and a night. Furthermore, I who am under the influence of lust and lure had to encounter this hindrance in my ascesis.

glosses.meaning: lust, lure, one who is influenced [i.e., me]
days, night, in the name of - as if they are one day and one night
above all, to near, came - encountered.

verses.devanagari:
विनिःश्वसन् मुनिवरः पश्चात्तापेन दुःखितः
भीतामप्सरसं दृष्ट्वा वेपन्तीं प्रांजलिं स्थिताम् |
मेनकां मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्विसृज्य कुशिकात्मजः
उत्तरं पर्वतं राम विश्वामित्रो जगाम ह |
verses.iast:
sa viniḥśvasan munivaraḥ paścāttāpena duḥkhitaḥ
bhītām apsarasam dṛṣṭvā vepantīm prāñjalim sthitām |
menakām madhuraiḥ vākyaiḥ visṛjya kuśika ātmajaḥ
uttaram parvatam rāma viśvāmitro jagāma ha |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, that best saint suspired heavily when he became emotional with reparation. But on seeing the scared celestial wench Menaka, who is shivering and waiting with suppliantly adjoined palms, he sent her away with pleasant words, and he that Vishvamitra indeed went to the northern Himalayan mountain.

glosses.meaning: one who is scared, with well-adjoined palms, staying [waiting]

verses.devanagari:
स कृत्वा नैष्ठिकीं बुद्धिं जेतुकामो महायशाः
कौशिकीतीरमासाद्य तपस्तेपे दुरासदम् |
verses.iast:
sa kṛtvā naiṣṭhikīm buddhim jetu kāmo mahāyaśāḥ
kauśikī tīram āsādya tapaḥ tepe durāsadam |
verses.translation: "He that highly celebrated sage who made a resolve to attain a sang-froid temperament and to vanquish lust, performed an unsurpassable ascesis on reaching the riverbank of River Kaushiki.

glosses.meaning: for sang-froid temperament, resolve, on making
lust [or, his desire to vanquish Vashishta]
River Kaushiki, riverbank, on getting at

verses.devanagari:
तस्य वर्षसहस्राणि घोरं तप उपासतः
उत्तरे पर्वते राम देवतानामभूद्भयम् |
verses.iast:
tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghoram tapa upāsataḥ
uttare par.hvate rāma devatānām abhūt bhayam |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, while he reverently performed an unspeakable ascesis for a thousand years on the northern mountain, namely Himalayas, then fear occurred to gods.

verses.devanagari:
आमंत्रयन् समागम्य सर्वे सर्षिगणाः सुराः
महर्षिशब्दं लभतां साध्वयं कुशिकात्मजः |
verses.iast:
amantrayan samāgaṃya sarve sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ surāḥ
maharṣi śabdam labhatām sādhu ayam kuśika ātmajaḥ |
verses.translation: "All gods coming together with assemblages of sages have approached Brahma and conveyed that, 'this Vishvamitra, the son of Kushika, may duly be given the epithet of 'Maharshi, Exalted Sage.'

glosses.meaning: let him get, may be given

verses.devanagari:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः
अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम् |
verses.iast:
devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka pitāmahaḥ
abravīt madhuram vākyam viśvāmitram tapo dhanam |
verses.translation: "On listening the advice of gods, Brahma, the Grandparent of all the worlds, spoke these pleasant words to the ascetically wealthy Vishvamitra.

verses.devanagari:
महर्षे स्वागतं वत्स तपसोग्रेण तोषितः
महत्त्वमृषिमुख्यत्वं ददामि तव कौशिक |
verses.iast:
maharṣe svāgatam vatsa tapasā ugreṇa toṣitaḥ
mahattvam ṛṣi mukhyatvam dadāmi tava kauśika |
verses.translation: " 'Oh, exalted sage, I welcome you my dear, as I am gladdened by your stern ascesis, oh, Kaushika, I bestow upon you the sublimity and supremacy among sages.'

glosses.meaning: by stern, ascesis [of yours,] [I am] gladdened

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मणः स वचः श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः
प्रांजलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच पितामहम् |
verses.iast:
brahmaṇaḥ sa vacaḥ śrutvā viśvāmitraḥ tapo dhanaḥ
prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā pratyuvāca pitāmaham |
verses.translation: " 'And on hearing the words of Brahma he that ascetically wealthy Vishvamitra became obeisant and replied the Grandparent adjoining his palms suppliantly.

glosses.meaning: with well-adjoined palms, obeisant, on becoming
to grandparent, in turn, said - replied.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मर्षिशब्दमतुलं स्वार्जितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः
यदि मे भगवानाह ततोऽहं विजितेन्द्रियः |
verses.iast:
brahmarṣi śabdam atulam sva ar.hjitaiḥ kar.hmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ
yadi me bhagavān āha tato aham vijita indriyaḥ |
verses.translation: " 'If your Godhead had said that I am a Brahma-sage, a sageship acquired personally by my pious deeds, rather than an exalted sage, then I would have become one who is really self-conquered.' Thus Vishvamitra said to Brahma.

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा न तावत्त्वं जितेन्द्रियः
यतस्व मुनिशार्दूल इत्युक्त्वा त्रिदिवं गतः |
verses.iast:
tam uvāca tato brahmā na tāvat tvam jita indriyaḥ
yatasva muni śārdūla iti uktvā tridivam gataḥ |
verses.translation: "Brahma then said to him, 'your senses remain unconquered as such, oh, tigerly sage, make an effort for it.' Saying so Brahma went heavenward.

glosses.meaning: you are, with conquered, senses, as such, not
make an effort - in that direction
thus, on saying, to heavenward, went.

verses.devanagari:
विप्रस्थितेषु देवेषु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्निरालंबो वायुभक्षस्तपश्चरन् |
verses.iast:
viprasthiteṣu deveṣu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
ūrdhva bāhuḥ nirālambo vāyu bhakṣaḥ tapaḥ caran |
verses.translation: "While the gods who came here along with Brahma have returned, that great sage Vishvamitra undertook another round of ascesis by standing in levitation, upraising his arms, and subsisting on air alone.

glosses.meaning: without, support - insecurely standing in levitation

verses.devanagari:
धर्मे पंचतपा भूत्वा वर्षास्वाकाशसंश्रयः
शिशिरे सलिले शायी रात्र्यहानि तपोधनः |
एवं वर्षसहस्रं हि तपो घोरमुपागमत्
verses.iast:
dharme pañca tapā bhūtvā varṣāsu ākāśa saṃśrayaḥ
śiśire salile śāyī rātri ahāni tapo dhanaḥ |
evam varṣa sahasram hi tapo ghoram upāgamat
verses.translation: "In summer he became the Five-Fire Ascetic, in rainy season open sky is his rooftop, and in winter water is his reclining bed even by day or by night, and thus that ascetically wealthy Vishvamitra indeed undertook a severe ascesis in this way, for another thousand years.
notes: Five fires are four Fires in four directions and the fifth one is the scorching sun, overhead. An ascetic staying among these five fires will become an ascetic fire. The first word in first foot dharme, will also used as gharme, as above, in some mms.

glosses.meaning: five, ascetic-fires, on becoming - among them
in rain [rainy season,] [open] sky, taking shelter [as rooftop]
severe, ascesis, he obtained - he undertook, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् संतप्यमाने तु विश्वामित्रे महामुनौ |
संतापः सुमहानासीत् सुराणां वासवस्य च
verses.iast:
tasmin santapyamāne tu viśvāmitre mahāmunau |
santāpaḥ sumahān āsīt surāṇām vāsavasya ca
verses.translation: "While that great saint is undertaking fervent ascesis it has become a very high burning problem to gods and even to Indra.

verses.devanagari:
रंभामप्सरसं शक्रः सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणैः |
उवाचात्महितं वाक्यमहितं कौशिकस्य च
verses.iast:
rambhām apsarasam śakraḥ saha sarvaiḥ marut gaṇaiḥ |
uvāca ātma hitam vākyam ahitam kauśikasya ca
verses.translation: "Then Indra along with all the assemblages of the Air-gods spoke to Rambha, the celestial wench, words that are advantageous to himself, but disadvantageous to the son of sage Kushi, namely Vishvamitra." Thus Sage Shataananda continued his narration.

glosses.meaning: with all, Air-gods', assemblages, along with
